verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a public GraphQL platform API for interacting with workflows and automating processes. Probes confirm a live llms.txt for the Platform API documentation and an OpenAPI spec, alongside granular scopes and SDKs. The community items are off-topic UI complaints and were ignored. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: An expressive GraphQL API to interact with your workflows, automate processes, power integrations, and more!
Use our flexible APIs, SDKs to build custom apps and integrations tailored to your  unique needs.
